title: Vietnam EInvoice Approve Schema
description: JSON Schema for Vietnam E-Invoice JSON file format. Our NewtonSoft JSON Schema Validator library supports only 'draft-03' schema version

lang.description: Language of error message returned from FPT. Only lowercase is acceptable for FPT.

sid.description: ReferenceID. It is a unique number of the record of enterprise.

form.description: Form No. {Form is invoice form no. that have been registered(Not Fixed)}

serial.description: Serial No. {Serial is invoice serial no. that have been registered(Not Fixed)}

stax.description: This is referring to the Current Login Branch's Organization Proxy VN VAT Registration Number and fallback to company organization proxy VAT number.

sendfile.description: Define whether send email attached invoice to customer or not: 1: send email to customer. Default to '1'
